data.short_description: BAI Cockpit - Web-based dashboard for business process analytics and insights
data.long_description:
The Business Automation Insights (BAI) Cockpit is the primary user interface for viewing and analyzing business process data. It provides real-time dashboards, custom reports, and analytics capabilities for monitoring business automation workflows, cases, and decisions.

If the Cockpit is down, users cannot access BAI dashboards, view process analytics, create custom reports, or monitor business metrics. This impacts business visibility, decision-making, and compliance reporting capabilities.

data.short_description: BAI Management Service - Backend API and data processing engine
data.long_description:
The Management Service is the core backend API and data processing engine for Business Automation Insights. It provides RESTful APIs for the Cockpit UI, coordinates event processing with Flink, manages data queries to OpenSearch, and handles authentication with Zen. The service runs two containers: a frontend API container (port 6898) and a backend processing container (port 8443).

If the Management Service is down, the Cockpit UI will be unable to retrieve analytics data, event processing coordination will fail, and users will not be able to access business insights. This impacts real-time monitoring, historical analytics, and business process visibility across all CP4BA components.

Verify backend health: oc exec deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management-backend -- curl -k https://localhost:8443/api/v1/health
